d: Tata Sons faces a major restructuring battle as Tata Trusts propose merging Tata Sons with Tata Electronics Systems Solutions and Tata Consulting Engineers, potentially avoiding an RBI-mandated public listing. The move comes amid tensions between Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata and Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran, raising questions over the Tata Group’s ownership, governance and potential IPO. Meanwhile, Pakistan has denied airspace clearance to a Russian cargo flight carrying nuclear fuel for Bangladesh’s Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant, delaying fuel delivery for Unit 2. Hem Saroya…
